title: Robert Bigelow's plan to hire the guest fell through

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. Robert Bigalow was going to hire me for his company at one time, too, and that also fell through.

plain: A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies what he calls alien implants, says the businessman Robert Bigelow, of the company Bigelow Aerospace, once planned to hire him, but the job fell through. Colbern tells Michels this himself, as one more opening that came to nothing.
